claims.claim: 80 Main Event games; 800 player rows; patch 7.18; no play-ins.
claims.limitation: The main OE download was discovered through a third-party configuration.

claims.claim: 15 primary versions selected by most games per team/role; Blank 9, Haru 1, Rascal 1 retained in research.
claims.limitation: Administrative non-playing roster registrations were not fully revalidated.

claims.claim: Six fallback associations are observed in LCK Summer 2017, independently checked.
claims.limitation: Our cohort includes playoffs; consulted pages separate them. Selected fallback picks have identical counts.

claims.claim: KP includes zero for a team with zero kills; aggregated facts agree within display rounding.
claims.limitation: Mean per-game KP differs from aggregate K+A/team kills.

claims.claim: All 40 playable champions have base art and icons extracted from the official 7.18.1 archive.
claims.limitation: Public distribution does not imply an unrestricted reuse license.

claims.claim: 2017 photos were not validated; champion art fallback is used for all 15 versions.
claims.confidence: high for implemented fallback; historical-photo availability unresolved
claims.limitation: Absence of a verified photo here does not mean no historical photo exists.

claims.claim: Ratings are descriptive estimates using explicit role/event normalization and sample regression; no official or reputation-based scores.
claims.limitation: No held-out predictive calibration, opposition-strength model or direct utility metrics.

claims.claim: 10,000 campaigns with fixed seed and production engine; balance dominance is reported without modifying ratings.
claims.limitation: Uniform bot choices and only three opponent rosters; not human preference or historical title probability.
